title: Setkage (staff)
body:
Syntax: setkage <player>  |  setkage <player> remove

Description: Implementor-only appointment of the Kage for a player's village. Kage is separate from the normal ninja rank ladder and is never earned by XP, missions, exams, PROMOTE or a mob program.

Only one Kage can exist per village. Appointing a replacement automatically relieves the current holder. Removing Kage leaves the earned ninja rank unchanged; older Kage saves recover their prior rank (or Jonin if unavailable).

&D(Staff only -- requires Implementor access.)&x

Date: 2026-11-12
